alt: A finished first relief carving of a wolf held up proudly in two hands in a home workshop
scene: Two hands hold up the finished panel from image 1, in the house finish, at chest height in a small home workshop, the carving facing the camera and fully visible between the hands, a modest desktop CNC router soft in the background. Warm evening light from a window at the left. The mood of a first finished piece. No face in frame.

alt: A blank cherry board clamped flat on a CNC spoilboard with four low clamps at the corners, ready to carve
scene: ON THE MACHINE, before any carving. A plain uncarved blank of pale cherry, about 25 by 30 cm and 25 mm thick, held flat on an MDF spoilboard by four low-profile aluminium clamps, one at each corner, well clear of the area to be carved; a small brass touch plate and a pencil mark for the origin at the front-left corner; a quarter inch flat end mill in the spindle above. Bright even workshop light. Nothing carved yet.

alt: The wolf design half way through the roughing pass, the right half still uncut blank and the left half stepped terraces
scene: ON THE MACHINE, MID ROUGHING PASS. The blank cherry board from before: its LEFT half has been roughed into coarse stair-step terraces that show the wolf and moon from image 1 only as blocky stepped silhouettes; its RIGHT half is still flat untouched blank wood. A quarter inch flat end mill is in the collet at the boundary with chips flying, fresh sawdust piling on the spoilboard. Raw pale wood, no finish. Bright workshop light.

alt: The back of the finished panel with a keyhole slot, felt bumpers and the maker's initials burned in
scene: The finished panel from image 1 lies FACE DOWN on the bench so its plain oiled back fills the frame: a clean keyhole hanger slot routed at the top centre, two small brown felt bumpers at the bottom corners, and a small burned mark near the bottom edge that is a simple abstract maker's mark (a tiny carved-chisel symbol, no letters). Beside it a hand holds a brass sawtooth hanger for comparison. Bright soft light. No words anywhere.
